A.F. LANDOLT
DIRECTOR
STATE OF ILLINOIS
DEPARTMENT OF AERONAUTICS
SPRINGFIELD 62705
April 21, 1972
RAY ANDERSON
Mr. Richard H. Golterman Under Secretary Chief Transportation Engineer Attention: Bureau of Planning Administration Building 2300 South 31st Street Springfield, Illinois 62706
RE: Environmental Statement F.A. Route 23 (U.S. Route 30) Section 22-23-12-R Cook County
Dear Mr. Golterman:
In accordance with the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, we have considered the above referenced project as to the environmental effects that might be under our jurisdiction or departmental expertise. It is the opinion of this office that the proposed development will not have any effect upon the environment relative to aeronautical users.
Very truly yours,
Allan F. Landolt
Director
